title: Planning a meeting and freeing joy
meaning: The time you create for pleasure supports closeness when free enjoyment need not be confirmed through matching reactions.
text: An organised meeting can feel wonderfully light when preparations leave you both freedom. The Emperor in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes arranging leisure: setting aside an evening, choosing a place and agreeing a few rules. The Lovers in energy lean towards expecting equal eagerness to participate, as though a different response might cast doubt on shared pleasure. The Sun in emotions allows enjoyment to be experienced openly: laughing, expressing yourselves and delighting in company. The plan makes the meeting possible, while warmth needs no identical display of feeling every minute.

Imagine choosing an evening for karaoke at home. Turns are clear and songs ready, but one person sings loudly while the other mostly smiles and listens. **Two people’s participation can look different and remain shared.** A little singing along or an amusing comment can join the pleasure without a compulsory solo. The format helps you express yourselves when it avoids measuring how much each person enjoys the meeting.

The difficulty starts if rules begin enforcing equal enthusiasm. You must sing as much, laugh alike and suggest the same number of songs. Open enjoyment becomes an account of reciprocity. Trying to preserve shared pleasure, you narrow its expression. Organisation helps while giving both wishes room. It need not govern emotional display for your evening to be warm and genuinely shared.
